items.exampleEn: Nothing in the report bears out such claims.
items.exampleZh: 報告中沒有任何內容能證實這類說法。

items.exampleEn: In the end, the choice boils down to money.
items.exampleZh: 說到底，這個選擇歸結起來就是錢的問題。

items.exampleEn: Such small complaints are usually brushed aside.
items.exampleZh: 這種小抱怨通常都會被置之不理。

items.exampleEn: A career in art is hard to build, but she carved one out for herself.
items.exampleZh: 在藝術界很難闖出一番事業，但她為自己闖出了一片天。

items.exampleEn: The sides of the sand castle caved in when the waves reached it.
items.exampleZh: 海浪打上來時，沙堡的四周就坍塌了。

items.exampleEn: How did this change come about?
items.exampleZh: 這個改變是怎麼發生的？

items.exampleEn: Unexpected costs often crop up on vacation.
items.exampleZh: 度假時常常會突然冒出意料之外的開銷。

items.sentenceEn: Nobody knows exactly how the idea came about.
items.sentenceZh: 沒有人確切知道這個點子是怎麼來的。

items.audioEn: The workers asked for higher pay for months, and in the end the company caved in and agreed.
items.audioZh: 員工要求加薪好幾個月，最後公司屈服並同意了。
options: It agreed to pay them more

items.sentenceEn: A few small problems cropped up during the move.
items.sentenceZh: 搬家時突然冒出幾個小問題。

items.sentenceEn: Most arguments boil down to a lack of trust.
items.sentenceZh: 大部分的爭吵歸根究柢都是缺乏信任。

items.stemEn: The manager ____ our concerns and moved on to the next topic.
items.stemZh: 經理對我們的疑慮置之不理，直接進入下一個話題。

items.stemEn: New data ____ the scientists' early predictions.
items.stemZh: 新的數據證實了科學家們早期的預測。

items.passageEn: Ten years ago, Nina left a safe job to start a company that makes furniture from recycled wood. Many people doubted her idea, but she slowly carved out a place for herself in a crowded market. Problems cropped up constantly: suppliers were late, machines broke down, and one large customer refused to pay. When journalists ask about her success, she says it boils down to two things: patience and a willingness to learn from mistakes. Her early sales figures bear this out: the first three years were difficult, but each year was better than the last.
items.passageZh: 十年前，Nina 辭去一份穩定的工作，創辦了一家用回收木材做家具的公司。很多人懷疑她的點子，但她慢慢在競爭激烈的市場中闖出了一席之地。問題接二連三地冒出來：供應商延誤交貨、機器故障，還有一位大客戶拒絕付款。記者問起她成功的原因時，她說歸根究柢就是兩件事：耐心，以及願意從錯誤中學習。她早期的銷售數字就證實了這一點：前三年很辛苦，但每一年都比前一年好。

options: 從國外進口高級的木製家具
把舊木材再利用做成家具

questions.questionZh: Nina 認為成功的關鍵是什麼？
options: 離開原本穩定的工作去冒險
找到願意準時交貨的供應商
說服大客戶付清所有的款項

items.promptZh: 實驗結果證實了她的說法。
referenceEn: The test results bore out her claim.
The results of the experiment bore her claim out.
rubricZh: 建議用片語表達「證實」（例如 bore out her claim、bore her claim out 等）
不用片語但意思正確也算對（例如 confirmed、supported、proved her claim 等）
時態可用過去式或現在完成式（例如 bore out、have borne out 等）

items.promptZh: 他在會議上對我的建議置之不理。
referenceEn: He brushed aside my suggestion at the meeting.
At the meeting, he brushed my suggestion aside.
rubricZh: 建議用片語表達「置之不理」（例如 brushed aside my suggestion 等）
不用片語但意思正確也算對（例如 ignored、dismissed、brushed off my suggestion 等）
時態可用過去式或現在完成式（例如 brushed aside、has brushed aside 等）
